details:
No story because we all already know the staff are updating(besides updating the safety side of vrchat), but if they want to get less tickets of these modified clients then this would be a great option:

as of now I have been crashed in the past 72 hours by each of the none fixed ones:

here is a list of anti's I have used in the past: ones that are listed as not fixed still crash players btw

Anti-crash includes: 

anti audio spam of event 1 which prevented high spam of audio which still happens to crash players audio systems.

anti shader: deletes certain shaders that have a high output which actually helped.

(Fixed)anti-portal drop: already fixed server-side.

anti-botting: prevents bots from joining a lobby if there are many of them at once.

anti-desync: prevents lobbies from having players from multiple instances join the lobby (basicially botting but syncing 

servers from different instances through actual users).

anti-particle: self-explanatory turns every particle off and yes "every particle" end quote.

anti-join audio: prevented avatars from using lobby join audio which would crash certain people who had there avatar on/shown fully.

so far in the past ive used these and have had no issue.

if someone is abusing the platform you should if at all possible be able to use a system that actually works.

the Current safety system is not an option anymore. it doesnt work at all agaisnt modified client users.

I do not care about eac anymore. eac isnt the problem its the safety system that does not work at all.
title: [FEATURE REQUEST]  adding a Extra-Safety Button option for settings tab in the quick menu.
